_notes_ships: The campaign's ship pick (docs/ship-pick-contract.md; read into GameData.ShipChoices, checked in game/sim/Data/ShipChoiceDefs.cs). In pick-screen order. id; name (the flagship's name, also in refusals: "the Tereshkova can't land a colony"); class_label; role colony|survey|courier|patrol|diplomacy; colonizes (true: lands the colony and plays a colony chain; false: never lands, starts in orbit of any body of the system and plays a space chain); chain (a rules.json chain: a colonizer's is a colony chain, any other ship's a space chain); crew (text); length_m; speed (divides the system's flight time for this player's flagship: 2 = twice as fast); card (res:// path of the pick screen's art); blurb; mission_title / mission_summary (the pick screen's 'Your mission' lines); start_bonus (resource: amount added to the landing stock) and start_units (surface unit ids that land with the colony, after the usual ones): colonizers only. Every number is a placeholder.

ships.name: Horizon
ships.blurb: Six drop ships land the colony. Extra colonists and habitat stock at the start.
ships.mission_summary: Land the colony, survey the world and build the first outpost.

ships.name: Cochrane
ships.blurb: Four drop ships land the colony. Extra spare-part kits and a construction rover at the start.
ships.mission_summary: Land the colony, survey the world and build the first outpost.

ships.name: Tereshkova
ships.blurb: Never lands. Charts the system body by body, places satellites, sweeps worlds for live data and chases a faint signal to the edge.
ships.mission_summary: Chart the system body by body, put satellites over the worlds that matter, sweep them for live data and run down a faint signal at the edge of the system.

ships.name: Armstrong
ships.blurb: Never lands. Timed runs between bodies: medicine, mail, a diplomatic pouch. The fastest ship, and the clock is always running.
ships.mission_summary: Timed runs between bodies: medicine, mail, a diplomatic pouch.

ships.name: Bastion
ships.blurb: Never lands. Patrols a route of bodies, inspects civilian traffic, answers a distress call and escorts a freighter home.
ships.mission_summary: Patrol a route, check civilian traffic, answer a distress call and escort a freighter.

ships.name: Meridian
ships.blurb: Never lands. Finds the system's living civilization, sets up a listening post, studies them and makes first contact.
ships.mission_summary: Find the system's civilization, hide a listening post, study them and make first contact.
